title: James G NDE 164
content: I was in a coma, gangrene right leg, heart failure, lungs -- pulmonary edema.

elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Void | Darkness | Light | A landscape or city | Life review
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes No pain, total peace and a glow around my body.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning There is no time as we know it in the afterlife.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I could hear people speaking buzzing sounds just like when you are awake but others cannot hear or see you.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes When I went into the valley or tunnel until the light appearing.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I spoke with the Lady who met me her name was Kathy she was a lady who had died years ago. She was a customer on my paper route when I was a teenager. I was told by her to wait that HE was coming to meet me that I would be back one day.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Light was total Love, Peace and the Power from it was awesome and unexplainable, the power of millions of atomic explosions would not even come close to the power.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Stood in the entrance way of the Kingdom.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control Total review of my entire life from day one to me being taken to Emory It was like a stage play I could watch but not stop any part of it. It made me appreciate life, it's precious, and a beautiful gift, enjoy it.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was told my time was not now, this made me sad to leave this beautiful Kingdom. I was cast back into darkness into earthly light and slammed into my body.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was told my time was not now, this made me sad to leave this beautiful Kingdom. I was cast back into darkness into earthly light and slammed into my body. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Life is a beautiful gift enjoy it while it lasts. I always did but even more now I believe in God Jesus and the life everlasting. Why I was chosen to experience this I have finally found out.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Life is a beautiful gift enjoy it while it lasts. I always did but even more now I believe in God Jesus and the life everlasting. Why I was chosen to experience this I have finally found out. After the NDE
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Seeing the Kingdom and having to comeback.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes As usual people tend to be skeptical, the human nature comes in. It changed my life forever I am not afraid of death I welcome it when my time really comes. Humans cannot fathom what is really around them. Too much to experience too little time to do it.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Even if it was not the afterlife, or the brain just preparing to die, do not be afraid it's the easiest most beautiful thing you're ever going to do.
